Login.gov Authentication method setup page showing options for multi-factor authentication: Face or touch unlock, Authentication application, Text or voice message (highlighted), and Security key, each with a brief description and icon.
Login.gov page for adding a phone number to receive a one-time code for sign-in, with options to get the code by text message or phone call, and a Send code button.

Login.gov page prompting user to enter a one-time code sent via SMS that expires in 10 minutes, with a field to input the code, a checkbox to remember the browser, a blue Submit button, and options to send another code, use a different phone number, get help if not receiving the code, and learn about authentication options.
Login.gov webpage showing a confirmation that a phone was added to the account and a prompt to set up face or touch unlock for a more secure sign-in with options to set up or skip.

Login.gov screen showing a message that a phone was added to the account, with an option to set up face or touch unlock for more secure sign in, including an explanation that this method is phishing-resistant and does not store face or fingerprint recordings, and buttons to set up face or touch unlock or to skip.

Login.gov page titled 'Continue to SSA' with a checkmark icon and user image illustration, showing that the email address will be shared with SSA. There is a warning to add a second authentication method to avoid losing access, and a blue button labeled 'Agree and continue' is highlighted.

Login.gov webpage titled 'Let's verify your identity for SSA' with instructions to complete identity verification by having a driver’s license or state ID, entering your Social Security number, matching your phone number, and re-entering your Login.gov password, followed by a blue Continue button and a Cancel link below.

Login.gov page showing the steps to verify identity: Getting started, Verify your ID, Verify your information, Verify your phone number, Re-enter your password. The page explains how verifying your identity works with sections on verifying identity by providing ID, phone number, and other information, and securing account through password encryption. A checkbox is checked to allow Login.gov to use personal information for verification. Below is a link to learn about privacy and security measures, and a blue Continue button with a cursor hovering over it. A Cancel link is at the bottom.

Screenshot of Login.gov verification step asking users to choose how to verify their ID with the current option to use a phone to take photos of ID and yourself, including a phone number input field and 'Send link' button, with progress indicators showing this is the 'Verify your ID' step.

LOGIN.GOV webpage for verifying your ID with two options: using your phone to take photos of your ID and yourself by entering a phone number and clicking 'Send link,' or going to a participating Post Office to verify identity in person, with buttons and links for both options.

Social Security website page for signing in or creating an account, offering sign-in options with LOGIN.GOV or ID.me, a notice about accepting SSA terms of service and privacy policy, and links to create accounts and sign-in help.

Login.gov webpage showing progress in account creation: Getting started completed, currently on Verify your ID. Message box warns: Do not close this window; the next step loads automatically after verifying ID on phone. Below, text says a message was sent to the phone, instructing user to check phone and follow instructions to take a photo of their ID. Navigation option to go back is available at the bottom.

Screenshot of a text message from Login.gov containing a one-time code 123456 that expires in 10 minutes, a link to secure.login.gov for identity verification, and instructions to take a photo of an ID to access SSA, with a prompt to report junk and a note that the sender is not in the contact list.

Instructions to add photos of a driver's license or state ID card with tips for clear photos such as using flat dark surface, well-lit place, and avoiding glare. Sections to upload front and back of the ID with placeholders and a 'Take photo' button under the front ID section.

Mobile screen with instructions to take photos of the front and back of a driver's license or state ID with labeled boxes and buttons: 'Take photo' under each box and a blue 'Continue' button at the bottom.

Login.gov verification screen instructing users to add a photo of their face for SSA access, with guidance to remove face-covering items, take the photo in a well-lit place, keep a neutral expression, and ensure the whole face fits within a green circle. A cartoon face illustration inside a green circle is shown with instructions to line up the face and hold still to capture the photo.

Instructions for adding a photo ID with tips and visuals. 'How to prepare for your photo' includes removing items covering the face, taking the photo in good light, keeping a neutral expression, and ensuring the face fits in a green circle. 'How to take your photo' shows a face aligned with a green circle and instructs to hold still for capture. Below, it shows tapping a green checkmark on the screen to accept the photo. A 'Take photo' button is at the bottom with a pointer hand icon.

Screen showing a photo submission interface with instructions to keep expression neutral and face visible within a green circle, a green-bordered rectangle indicating photo upload, a message 'Image updated' with a green checkmark, and buttons labeled 'Retake photo', 'Submit' with a hand cursor icon hovering over it, and 'Cancel'.

Login.gov webpage showing the process at the 'Verify your ID' step with a message saying 'We are processing your images' and a note that it might take up to a minute and will load the next step automatically, with a hand cursor icon pointing to the message. Options for Language, Help, Contact, Privacy & security, and Accessibility statement are visible at the bottom.

A Login.gov page showing identity verification progress with 'We verified your identity document' and instruction to switch back to computer to finish verifying identity, including icons of a phone and a computer.

Login.gov webpage for entering Social Security number with steps progress bar showing 'Verify your information' highlighted, instructions about verifying identity, a masked Social Security number input box, option to show the number, and blue Continue button with Cancel link below.

Login.gov page showing that SSA uses Login.gov to enable safe, secure sign-in. Two buttons labeled 'Sign in' and 'Create an account' appear above fields to sign in with email address and password, plus a submit button.

Login.gov webpage showing a verification form where users confirm their information including name, date of birth, ID number, address, and Social Security number, with options to update address and SSN details, a checkbox to show Social Security number, and buttons to submit or cancel.

United States government Login.gov page with progress steps showing 'Verify your phone number' as active, asking the user to enter a one-time code sent via text (SMS) that expires in 10 minutes, with input field, submit button, option to send another code, use another phone number, or cancel.

Login.gov password re-entry webpage showing progress steps completed for getting started, verifying ID, verifying information, and verifying phone number, with password input field, show password checkbox, forgotten password link, continue button, and cancel link.

Login.gov account creation screen showing progress steps with four steps completed and the fifth step Re-enter your password pending. A message indicates verified information is secured. Screen showing a message that verified information is secured and instructing to save a personal key displayed as '1A2B - 3C4D - 5E6F - 7G8H' above an icon of a red shield. A checkbox labeled 'I saved my personal key in a safe place' is shown with a cursor hovering over it, and a blue Continue button is below.

User interface page titled 'Connect your verified information to SSA' showing a list of shared verified data with SSA, including email address, full name, address, phone number, date of birth, and Social Security number, each marked with a green checkmark.
